facts.text: Policy DMN-001: never restart the daemon while a translation task is running.
Policy UNDO-002: shell checkpoints must retain preimages of removed files as well as newly created paths.
The loopback model tunnel is enabled only when traveling away from home. At home, use the direct LAN endpoint.
Unanswered tool permission requests are human approval waits, not agent hangs.
Inference server HOST-046 listens at 192.168.1.46:1234 and exposes an OpenAI compatible API.
Experiment TRANS-006 found that translating Russian requests through English reduced task correctness.
Past conversations can be searched within the workspace and read around their saved event numbers.
Project memory must never leak a workspace-specific secret into another repository.
Telegram topic TG-009 has a persistent binding to exactly one agent conversation.
Browser interaction uses snapshot element references for click and type operations.
Experiment siblings keep immutable source snapshots and compare measured metrics against a baseline.
Remote SSH commands must propagate cancellation and bound their captured stdout and stderr.
Composite recipe stages run in isolated sessions and share a tighter total budget.
Webhook delivery EVT-014 requires authentication and a durable idempotency key to reject retries.
Review findings attach severity and exact source file and line; the reviewer does not edit the workspace.
Memory embedding cache EMB-016 is bounded, local, versioned by model and falls back to keyword retrieval.
Перевод экрана приложения доступен через настройки языка интерфейса.
Новая сеть дома использует отдельный пароль от рабочего Wi-Fi.
Команда запускает сервер игры на удалённом компьютере каждую пятницу.
English documents must use a consistent spelling of product names.
Linux package manager commands may require administrator permissions.
The browser toolbar can be hidden to make more room for the page.
Annual expense reports compare travel costs against a planned budget.
The family messaging group contains unrelated meal planning discussions.
An archive stores backup source files from last year.
